reviews.title: Ads not able to close and it make us not able to access the app
reviews.text: Meet You has always open an ads first before entering the app. This is ok as the app is free. The problem is, it recently showing an app that can’t be close and the ads will not disappear automatically! Is that asking us to give up on using the app and use other app?? This is so annoying!

reviews.title: Disappointing experience
reviews.text: I had trouble navigate the app, and some features felt confusing. It didn’t meet my experience overall.

reviews.title: Very bad app
reviews.text: This app doesn’t work. It doesn’t work to tell me the days. I’m gonna have my period and it always mix up. This app is the best app I ever have.

reviews.title: PLEASE MOVE CONTINUE TO APP BUTTON!!!
reviews.text: I love this app and have used it for a few years now. The continue to app button has been placed in such a bad place on my iPhone that it makes it more or less impossible to select to access the app. Unfortunately I think I will have to move to another tracker app if it doesn’t get changed soon.
